text:
### Observed differences

- In the earlier window, A19, A20 and A21 each ran in roughly 30–36 in 100 traces and almost never together (in about two thirds of traces exactly one of a pair appears, with both in at most about 1 in 200), so they behaved like alternative single-activity paths; in the later window each appears in only about 1 in 200 traces. [OCC002, OCC003, OCC004, REL007, REL008, REL016]
- A26 and A27 were not observed in any of the 200 earlier traces and A28 in about 1 in 200; in the later window all three run in every one of the 200 traces. [OCC005, OCC006, OCC007, REL031, REL032, REL037]
- The new trio occupies the slot the old activities held. Earlier, A44 preceded A19/A20/A21 in about 34 in 100 traces (essentially whenever they co-occurred) and passed control to A19, A20, A21 and A10 in roughly equal shares (about 23–27 in 100 of its outgoing transitions each), while A19/A20/A21 led to A29 in 97–99 in 100 of theirs. Later, A44 precedes each of A26/A27/A28 in about 995 of 1000 joint appearances, A44's outgoing transitions go to A26, A28 and A27 (about 30–33 in 100 each), and each of the trio precedes A29 in about 99 in 100. [REL012, REL013, REL021, REL028, REL033, REL038, REL042, REL034, REL039, REL043, DIR003, DIR004, DIR005, DIR009]
- Within the trio there is no fixed order: A26, A27 and A28 co-occur in every later trace, each pair appears in both orders in near-equal shares (A26 before A27 in 50 vs 49 in 100; A26 before A28 in 50 vs 49; A27 before A28 in 52 vs 48), and each of the three also passes control to the other two and to A29. [REL031, REL032, REL037, DIR006, DIR007, DIR008]
- The positional distance from A44 to A29 grew from usually 2 event positions (about 75 in 100 cases, most of the rest 3) to usually 4 (about 90 in 100), consistent with one activity being replaced by a block of three. [LAG005]
- A10 receded: it appeared in about 26 in 100 traces earlier versus about 11 in 100 later, and its outgoing mix shifted from mainly A21, A19 and A20 (about 40, 26 and 19 in 100 of its outgoing transitions) to a spread led by A27 and A15 with many minor targets (later profile based on 23 traces). [OCC001, DIR001]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The number of qualifying items (66, all control-flow) is many times the fewer than 1 expected for an unchanged process, so chance cannot account for the pattern as a whole. The evidence directly and consistently supports the hypothesis that the alternative step formed by A19, A20 and A21 — each taken in roughly a third of cases, essentially never together, between A44 upstream and A29 downstream — was replaced in the later window by a block of three activities, A26, A27 and A28, which now execute in every case in varying order in the same slot: A44 precedes them in about 995 of 1000 joint appearances, each precedes A29 in about 99 in 100, and the A44-to-A29 distance grew from about 2 to about 4 positions, matching three activities replacing one. [OCC002, OCC003, OCC004, OCC005, OCC006, OCC007, REL031, REL033, REL034, REL038, REL039, REL042, REL043, DIR009, LAG005]

The evidence cannot show whether A26/A27/A28 are genuinely new activities or relabelled counterparts of A19/A20/A21, nor whether the trio is an unordered block or a repeating loop, since every pair occurs in both orders in near-equal shares; the later outgoing profiles of A19/A20/A21 rest on a single trace each, and the residual appearances of the old activities (about 1 in 200 traces) could be sampling noise. [REL031, REL037, DIR003, DIR004, DIR005, OCC002]

Other differences: A10's participation fell from about 26 to 11 in 100 traces and its outgoing transitions redistributed from mainly A21/A19/A20 to a spread including A27, A15, A26, A48 and A47 [OCC001, DIR001]; A46 now co-occurs with A26 in about 58 in 100 traces (A26 first in about 44), whereas earlier it co-occurred with A19/A20/A21 in about 21–26 in 100 with the old activity first in about 15–19 [REL015, REL023, REL030, REL036, REL041, REL045]; A45 still follows the slot's activity, now directly after A26/A27/A28 in about 63 in 100 cases with about 37 interleaved, similar to its earlier relation to A19/A20/A21 [REL014, REL022, REL029, REL035, REL040, REL044].
